recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic-leaning portrait of a man with voluminous 80s hair, leaning against a heavily textured stucco wall. The composition is centered and features a distinctive 'echo' or 'ghosting' typographic effect at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair and shadows against the light, rough-textured wall
The repetition of text creating a sense of depth and motion
The stark contrast between the crisp white shirt and the deep shadows on the subject's skin
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting with a circular vignette shadow behind the head
Italicized serif typography with a semi-transparent offset shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close shot, subject occupies the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and intense gaze, framed by dark, voluminous hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold green text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the arms down to the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured wall provides significant negative space on the left and right sides, emphasizing the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, relying on extreme value contrast between light and dark areas.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic base with a single muted accent color

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with thin hairlines and thick stems

treatment.shadow: Semi-transparent grey 'echo' offset to the right and down

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying opacity for the shadow effect.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the era.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a man with 1980s styled voluminous hair and a mullet, wearing a white button-down shirt with rolled sleeves. He is leaning against a rough, heavily textured stucco wall. A subtle circular shadow is cast on the wall behind his head. The lighting is dramatic, creating deep shadows on his face and arms.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place uppercase, bold, italicized serif text in dark green across the top. Add a secondary layer of the same text in semi-transparent grey, offset slightly to the right and down to create a ghosted echo effect.

verificationChecks: Is the stucco texture prominent and tactile?
Does the text have the specific 'echo' shadow effect?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks and bright whites?
Is the hair styled in a distinct 80s fashion?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vignette shadow behind the head
Specific shade of the green accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos or specific names
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's hair.
Ensure the stucco texture doesn't look like digital noise.
Verify the 'echo' text is legible but clearly secondary.
Confirm the high-contrast lighting maintains detail in the white shirt.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast textured portrait with 'echoed' serif typography to create a vintage-inspired promotional visual.
